description.value: Mutsuki-An is a neighbourhood Japanese restaurant tucked into Victoria's Gordon Head area on the eastern edge of the city. The restaurant operates a focused menu of Japanese cuisine and makes their menu available for download on their website. It offers a quiet, local dining option for cyclists exploring the communities east of downtown Victoria.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 64m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the business is active with a current menu notice and contact details. The OSM address, phone number, and website URL all match the website content exactly (2560A Sinclair Rd, (250) 595-0378). The website contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those fields are null. A minor name discrepancy exists: OSM uses 'Mutsuki-An Japanese Restaurant' while the website uses 'Mutsuki-An Restaurant'.
concerns: Minor name mismatch: OSM uses 'Mutsuki-An Japanese Restaurant' but the website uses 'Mutsuki-An Restaurant' (drops 'Japanese').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating Japanese restaurant in Victoria with a live website and confirmed contact details. A useful dining stop for cyclists in the Gordon Head area.
